operation: run theorem_footprint_batch_audit once with output redirected durably; record only root hashes, footprint, and direct theorem dependency names
decision_rule: Factor a target-owned exact theorem over the smallest arithmetic contracts among its direct dependencies. Prefer already clean modulo-two and integer-constructor supports; do not copy the official proof or tactic trace.
limitations: Dependency names and footprints are localization evidence only, not proof authority.
